skill.name: 1Password Credential Lookup
skill.description: Look up website credentials from a signed-in 1Password account by domain and optional username.
skill.summary: Find the correct 1Password login for a website using its saved URL.
skill.author: ClementWalter

security_audit.summary: Static findings in Markdown and fixed 1Password CLI invocation are false positives. The skill intentionally retrieves credentials, but it prints plaintext passwords and uses overbroad substring matching that can select credentials for an unrelated saved URL.

remediation.issue: Passwords are returned through standard output.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before retrieval and pass secrets through a protected secret channel or directly to an approved login action. Avoid logging or displaying passwords.

remediation.issue: Saved URLs are selected with substring matching.
remediation.suggestion: Parse URLs and compare normalized hostnames with explicit alias handling. Reject lookalike domains and require user confirmation when several matches remain.

remediation.issue: The script lists all vault items before filtering.
remediation.suggestion: Use a narrowly scoped 1Password query or dedicated vault and limit the integration to required login items.

semantic_findings.title: Plaintext credential disclosure through command output
semantic_findings.description: The credential lookup path includes username and password values in JSON written to standard output. Any agent or process that receives this output can access the plaintext password.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The script constructs output objects from extracted password fields at both locations, and the documentation explicitly describes password-bearing output.

semantic_findings.title: Overbroad domain matching can select unrelated credentials
semantic_findings.description: URL matching accepts a requested domain when it appears anywhere in a saved URL. A domain such as github.com.evil.example can match github.com and may return an unintended credential.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code uses substring containment rather than validating the parsed hostname or a domain boundary.

content.value_statement: Finding the correct login item is difficult when item titles do not match website names. This skill searches saved 1Password URLs and can filter results by username.
actual_capabilities: Searches 1Password login items by a requested website domain.
Filters a matching login by an optional username.
Supports the x.com and twitter.com domain alias.
Returns account choices when several items match a domain.
Reports missing 1Password CLI and sign-in timeout errors.
limitations: Requires the 1Password CLI and an authenticated local session.
Only supports the configured x.com and twitter.com domain alias.
Returns plaintext passwords through command output.
Substring URL matching can select a lookalike or unrelated saved URL.

use_cases.title: Open a known website account
use_cases.description: Find a saved login for a website before an approved sign-in action.

use_cases.title: Choose a work account
use_cases.description: List matching accounts and filter by username when a website has several saved logins.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot credential lookup
use_cases.description: Identify missing CLI installation, sign-in, or no-match conditions during local automation.

prompt_templates.title: Find a website login
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my 1Password credential for github.com. Ask for confirmation before revealing any password.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by username
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the 1Password login for linkedin.com using the username work@example.com. Show only the matching account name until I confirm.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve several accounts
prompt_templates.prompt: List my saved accounts for github.com without passwords. Ask me which username I want before retrieving credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Use an approved login
prompt_templates.prompt: For the approved site github.com, find the login for work@example.com and use it only to complete the current sign-in. Do not display or log the password.

output_examples.input: Find the login for github.com using work@example.com.

output_examples.output: No saved login was found for the requested domain.

best_practices: Confirm the website domain and intended account before retrieving a password.
Use a username filter when multiple accounts are available.
Keep passwords out of chat history, logs, and terminal output whenever possible.
anti_patterns: Do not guess 1Password item names from a website name.
Do not retrieve a password before the user confirms the selected account.
Do not rely on substring domain matches for sensitive login decisions.

faq.question: What does this skill search?
faq.answer: It searches saved 1Password login items using the website URL field.

faq.question: What software is required?
faq.answer: You need the 1Password CLI installed and signed in locally.

faq.question: Can I select a specific account?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the username when more than one login may exist.

faq.question: Why should I use a domain instead of an item name?
faq.answer: Item titles can be arbitrary, while saved URLs usually identify the website.

faq.question: Does it support domain aliases?
faq.answer: It treats x.com and twitter.com as equivalent.

faq.question: Are passwords protected in the output?
faq.answer: No. The current script returns plaintext passwords, so use it only with explicit approval and secure output handling.
